recipes.title: Smoked Pulled Pork
recipes.description: Hickory-smoked pork shoulder for Monday's Smokehouse dinner.
instructions: Trim and season the pork shoulder.
Smoke at 225°F; spritz every 45 minutes after bark forms.
Pull at 203°F and rest at least 1 hour.

recipes.title: Smoked Beef Brisket
recipes.description: Oak-smoked brisket for Wednesday dinner.
instructions: Wrap at 170°F with beef tallow; raise pit to 250°F if needed.
Pull when probe tender near 203°F and rest at least 2 hours.

recipes.title: 3-2-1 Smoked Ribs
recipes.description: Cherry-and-apple smoked ribs for Friday dinner.
instructions: Wrap with butter, honey and apple juice.
Unwrap, glaze and finish meat-side up.

recipes.title: Greek Chicken Skewers
recipes.description: Lemon, garlic and oregano chicken thighs.

recipes.title: Greek Beef Skewers
recipes.description: Sirloin marinated with red wine, lemon and herbs.

recipes.title: Tzatziki
recipes.description: Greek yogurt, cucumber and dill dip.

recipes.title: Greek Salad (Horiatiki)
recipes.description: Tomatoes, cucumber, feta and olives.

recipes.title: Crispy Roasted Potatoes
recipes.description: Parboiled Yukon Gold potatoes roasted crisp.
instructions: Drain and shake to roughen edges.

recipes.title: Classic Caesar Salad
recipes.description: Main River Feast Caesar salad with a make-ahead gluten-free dressing.
recipes.gfOption: The dressing is gluten-free when made with French's Worcestershire Sauce. Prepare Steve and Adele's salad first with a separate clean bowl, tongs and GF croutons.
instructions: Whisk garlic, anchovy paste, lemon juice, Dijon and French's Worcestershire together.
Whisk in the mayonnaise until smooth.
Stir in ¾ cup grated Parmigiano-Reggiano, salt and pepper.
Wash and spin the romaine completely dry.
Store the lettuce chilled with paper towels.
Shave the remaining Parmesan and keep refrigerated.
Prepare Steve and Adele's salad first in a clean separate bowl using GF croutons.
Toss the remaining romaine with dressing a little at a time.
Finish with Parmesan and regular croutons, then serve immediately.

recipes.title: Creamy Coleslaw
recipes.description: Make-ahead cabbage and carrot slaw.
instructions: Combine and refrigerate at least 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mimi's Potato Salad
recipes.description: Classic yellow-potato and egg salad.

recipes.title: Baked Mac & Cheese
recipes.description: Four-cheese baked macaroni.
recipes.gfOption: Use GF pasta, GF flour and GF breadcrumbs.
instructions: Combine, top with panko and bake at 375°F.

recipes.title: BBQ Grilled Chicken
recipes.description: Bone-in chicken with dry rub and GF BBQ sauce.
instructions: Brush sauce near the end and cook to 165°F.

recipes.title: Sous Vide Filet Mignon
recipes.description: Medium-rare filet with cast-iron finish.
instructions: Dry well and sear in cast iron.

recipes.title: Steamed Whole Lobster
recipes.description: Maritime lobster with drawn butter and lemon.
instructions: Bring salted water to a strong boil/steam.
Serve with drawn butter and lemon.

recipes.title: Strawberry Shortcake
recipes.description: Macerated strawberries, biscuits and whipped cream.
recipes.gfOption: Bake a separate batch with GF biscuit mix.

recipes.title: Fudgy Dark Chocolate Brownies
recipes.description: Dark chocolate brownies with flaky salt.
instructions: Combine and bake at 350°F for 28–32 minutes.

recipes.title: Fresh Guacamole
recipes.description: Large-batch lime and cilantro guacamole.
instructions: Serve immediately with GF tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Taco Fiesta Spiced Chicken
recipes.description: Grilled chicken thighs for taco night.

recipes.title: Taco Fiesta Ground Beef
recipes.description: Seasoned ground beef for taco night.

recipes.title: Pressed Italian Sandwiches
recipes.description: Large oven-warmed pressed Italian sandwiches for the Yacht Rock dock party.
recipes.gfOption: Make two separate GF sandwiches using GF rolls and a clean board/knife.
instructions: Split loaves and layer meats, provolone, peppers and olive spread.
Wrap tightly in foil and warm at 350°F until cheese melts.
Press under a sheet pan for 10 minutes, then slice into portions.
Prepare GF sandwiches first and wrap separately.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
recipes.description: Make-ahead broccoli, bacon and cheddar salad for the Main River Feast.
instructions: Whisk mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper.
Combine broccoli, bacon, cheddar, onion and sunflower seeds.
Fold in dressing and refrigerate at least 2 hours.

recipes.title: Garlic White Wine Mussels
recipes.description: Mussels steamed with garlic, butter, herbs and white wine.
instructions: Scrub and debeard mussels; discard cracked or open shells that do not close.
Sauté garlic in butter in large pots.
Add wine, bring to a boil, add mussels and cover.
Steam until opened, 5–8 minutes; discard unopened mussels.

recipes.title: Shrimp Cocktail Platter
recipes.description: Simple make-ahead party platter for Saturday and Sunday happy hour.
instructions: Arrange over ice with lemon wedges.
Serve cocktail sauce separately and keep cold.

recipes.title: Charcuterie & Cheese Board
recipes.description: Dock-party grazing board that also supplies Sunday's light lunch.
recipes.gfOption: Use a separate board area and sealed GF crackers for Steve and Adele.
instructions: Arrange cheeses and meats in groups.
Add fruit, olives, pickles and condiments.
Keep GF crackers sealed and separate until serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Wraps
recipes.description: Grilled chicken, romaine and Caesar dressing in regular and gluten-free wraps.
instructions: Toss romaine lightly with dressing and Parmesan.
Fill wraps and roll tightly; prepare gluten-free wraps first.

recipes.title: Lobster Rolls
recipes.description: Chilled Maritime lobster salad served in buttered rolls.
instructions: Combine lobster, mayonnaise, celery, green onion and lemon.

recipes.title: Steak Sandwiches
recipes.description: Warm leftover filet sandwiches with onions and horseradish mayonnaise.
instructions: Mix mayonnaise and horseradish, then assemble sandwiches.

recipes.title: Smoky Baked Beans
recipes.description: Sweet and smoky beans for pulled pork dinner.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a baking dish.

recipes.title: Pulled Pork Nachos
recipes.description: Sheet-pan nachos using leftover smoked pulled pork.
instructions: Layer chips, pork, cheese and jalapeño.
Bake at 400°F until hot and melted.
Top with green onion and serve with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Cornbread
recipes.description: Tender pan cornbread that everyone can share.
instructions: Whisk milk, eggs and butter separately.
Combine and bake at 400°F for 22–28 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Large-batch cottage chocolate chip cookies.
instructions: Beat in eggs and vanilla, then add dry ingredients and chocolate chips.

recipes.title: Brisket Sandwiches
recipes.description: Warm leftover brisket sandwiches with pickles and barbecue sauce.
instructions: Warm brisket with a small amount of sauce.
Assemble with pickles and additional sauce.

recipes.title: Garden Salad
recipes.description: Simple mixed garden salad with gluten-free vinaigrette.
instructions: Toss with dressing immediately before serving.
